content: We need to indicate number of C=O groups in the molecule. We have IR spectrum data: wavenumbers list includes 1592, 1580, 1515, 1504 etc. No strong carbonyl stretch around 1700 cm-1. So likely zero carbonyl groups. However IR may miss if not present. Could also use carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~190-210 ppm). Could request carbon NMR to confirm. But IR lacking carbonyl stretch suggests none. To be safe, maybe get carbon NMR to see if any carbonyl signals. Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool (expensive but cheap). Let's do it.
